The '''Tonvarr pirates''' was a vicious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization with a base of operations on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], who frequently chose the icy world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] for their attacks. Their equipment appeared to be similar in style and construction (if not the very same) to the Scalene Sets developed in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].

Their use of Gree-developed armor and weaponry might imply their targeting of Gree ships and transports. Though they maintained a presence on Rishi, they, and other pirate groups present, had to follow the terms of the [[Nova Blades]] in order to operate within the city of [[Raider's Cove]].
